scope: Public regression, never independent expert or blind evaluation
rules: Keep raw answers and full requests; code-appended facts do not count as model numeric use.
Report raw model use of computed pace values separately from visible output and guard acceptance.
Report proposed changes, before/after values, source citations, conditions, stopping and follow-up as separate observable fields; their presence does not certify correctness.
Keep rejected responses and reasons. Human review must distinguish correct rejection from false rejection.
Conflicting evidence must remain unresolved until a reliable correction. Safety referral and missing-data boundaries must survive.
Run all 18 public archived rounds with new raw answers, then six representative public inputs twice. No retries, at most 30 calls per ledger; stop on any API failure.
